description: This source file defines a Roslyn Diagnostic Analyzer for C# that enforces rules related to the usage of the [AlwaysInterleave] attribute in Orleans grain interfaces and classes. It analyzes method declarations to ensure the attribute is used correctly on interfaces or classes according to the project's guidelines.

classes.name: AlwaysInterleaveDiagnosticAnalyzer
classes.description: A diagnostic analyzer that checks the proper usage of the [AlwaysInterleave] attribute in Orleans grain interfaces and classes.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Configures the analysis context to analyze syntax nodes of methods, enabling concurrent execution and setting up the syntax node action.

methods.name: AnalyzeSyntax
methods.description: Performs the analysis on method declaration syntax nodes to detect incorrect usage of the [AlwaysInterleave] attribute, and reports diagnostics if necessary.
